scholarships.title: Bicocca International Scholarship Programme (BISP) — Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca

existing.description: The Bicocca International Scholarship Programme (BISP) is a merit award from the University of Milano-Bicocca for international students who hold a foreign qualification, are not resident in Italy and are admitted to one of the University's English-taught degree programmes. Around 100 scholarships are awarded each year, with five dedicated to each eligible English-taught course, mainly at Master's level. Each scholarship is worth EUR 10,000 gross per academic year plus exemption from tuition fees, and is renewable for a maximum of three years on Bachelor's and single-cycle degree programmes and two years on Master's degree programmes. No separate application is needed: applying to an eligible programme makes the candidate automatically part of the selection, and applicants are not required to submit any further form.
eligibility: Holds a non-Italian entry qualification that allows admission to the Italian university system for the desired course
Does not possess Italian citizenship, except dual citizenship that includes Italian
Is admitted to one of the degree programmes specified in the call; the admission offer counts as accepted once the deposit has been received
existing.eligibility_summary: International students resident abroad who hold a non-Italian entry qualification that allows admission to the Italian university system, do not hold Italian citizenship (dual citizenship including Italian is eligible), obtained their previous degree abroad, are not resident in Italy, and are admitted to one of the programmes covered by the call.
requirements: Apply to an eligible English-taught programme; no separate scholarship application form is required
Be admitted and confirm the admission offer by the programme's deadline, with 15 March 2026 being the key date for free entrance courses in the 2026/2027 call
For limited-access programmes, complete all the admission steps required by the programme
Officially accept the scholarship offer by the deadline given
Confirm that the candidate is not a beneficiary of any other scholarships
Fulfil the enrolment requirements within the given deadline
For non-EU students, meet the requirements for an Italian student visa (D) for enrolment
Complete enrolment in the selected degree programme following checks on document authenticity and enrolment eligibility
Arrive in Milan by 31 October 2026 for the 2026/2027 award, otherwise the first instalment is not paid
documents: Admission application to the relevant Bachelor's, single-cycle or Master's programme through apply.unimib.it
Payment of the admission deposit, which confirms the admission offer
Documents required by the chosen degree programme's admission call
existing.english_requirement: The scholarship applies only to degree programmes taught in English. No separate English language certificate is required by the scholarship itself; admission to the programme governs any language requirement.
application_method: Apply for admission to an eligible English-taught degree programme through the Dream Apply platform at apply.unimib.it
Pay the admission deposit, which constitutes acceptance of the admission offer
Complete the admission steps required by the chosen programme, including any limited-access ranking
No further form is submitted: the candidate is automatically included in the scholarship selection
Await the scholarship offer delivered through the Dream Apply platform and the registered email address
Accept the offer, confirm no other scholarships, complete enrolment and meet the visa requirement where applicable
Arrive in Milan by 31 October 2026 and satisfy the credit milestones to keep the award
existing.selection_notes: Five scholarships are assigned to the best candidates on each eligible course, and the number may be increased at the discretion of the awarding body if additional funds become available. Selection results are published on apply.unimib.it by mid-April for free-access study programmes and following the publication of the admission ranking list for limited-access programmes. If a candidate withdraws, the Commission proceeds down the ranking and the next eligible candidate is notified through the Dream Apply messaging section. Priority is given to candidates who applied in the first Call for Admission.
existing.duration: Up to 3 years for Bachelor's and single-cycle degree programmes; up to 2 years for Master's degree programmes
existing.application_period: Aligned with each degree programme's admission calls, referred to on the apply.unimib.it website. For 2026/2027 the key milestone was confirmation of admission by 15 March 2026 for free entrance courses, with a second session reflected in a further ranking decree on 15 July 2026.
existing.deadline_display: There is no separate scholarship application form: the deadline is the admission deadline of the chosen degree programme. For the 2026/2027 call, candidates on free entrance courses had to be admitted and confirm their admission offer by 15 March 2026, and results were published by mid-April 2026 for free-access programmes and after the admission ranking list for limited-access programmes. The 2026/2027 cycle is complete, with ranking decrees issued on 28 April 2026 and 15 July 2026.
existing.program_type: University merit scholarship for international students enrolling in English-taught degree programmes, awarded automatically through the admission ranking

scholarships.title: ISU Bocconi Scholarship — First-Year Students a.y. 2027-28 (Right to University Education Scholarship)

existing.description: The ISU Bocconi Scholarship is Bocconi University's implementation of the Italian Right to University Education Scholarship for students entering the first year of a Bachelor of Science, Integrated Master of Arts in Law or Master of Science programme in academic year 2027-2028. It combines a cash stipend with services and supplements, including a free daily meal valued at EUR 829.00 for a.y. 2026-27, access to preferential-rate canteen services and a 200-hour work-study programme. Eligibility depends on three separate tests: enrolment for the absolute first year, an economic test set annually by the Lombardy Region (ISEE/ISEEU Parificato not above EUR 26,887.93 and ISPE/ISPEEU Parificato not above EUR 58,452.06 for a.y. 2026-27), and a merit test verified after the fact through credit thresholds. International candidates apply under this call, while Bocconi and Italian applicants are directed to the separate Bocconi4Access to Education call.
eligibility: Enrolled in a.y. 2027-2028 for the absolute first year of enrolment in a regular year of a Bachelor of Science, Integrated Master of Arts in Law or Master of Science programme

The absolute first year means any prior academic year of first enrolment in any degree programme requiring the same education qualification, at any university in Italy or abroad, even if not completed
Meets the economic requirements set annually by the Lombardy Region: for a.y. 2026-27, ISEE/ISEEU Parificato not above EUR 26,887.93 and ISPE/ISPEEU Parificato not above EUR 58,452.06

Meets the merit requirement, verified ex post: at least 44 credits by 10 August 2028 for Bachelor of Science or Integrated master of Arts in Law students, and 39 credits by 10 August 2028 for Master of Science students
First-year Bachelor of Science and Law applicants must have submitted the Bocconi4Access to Education a.y. 2027-2028 application within its deadlines
Does not fall within any of the grounds for exclusion listed in the call
existing.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled for the absolute first year in a regular-year Bachelor of Science, Integrated Master of Arts in Law or Master of Science programme at Bocconi in a.y. 2027-2028, who satisfy the economic thresholds set annually by the Lombardy Region and the merit credit requirement. First-year Bachelor of Science and Law applicants must have previously submitted the single Bocconi4Access to Education application for a.y. 2027-2028.
benefits: Cash stipend (amount set annually by the Lombardy Region and not published on the call pages read)
Free daily meal, valued at EUR 829.00 for a.y. 2026-27
Possible further integrations, subject to availability
coverage: Cash stipend (amount set annually by the Lombardy Region and not published on the call pages read)
Free daily meal, valued at EUR 829.00 for a.y. 2026-27
Possible further integrations, subject to availability
requirements: Application must be submitted through the online procedure and finalised by clicking "Complete data" and "Submit application" within the final deadline
Applications submitted after the deadline or in a different modality will not be evaluated for the award
The online procedure will ask for information on requirements, status, family household, income, entrepreneurial activities and company shares
Only the deadlines published on the deadlines page are valid; dates shown inside the online procedure reflect system management and must be ignored

The submitted ISEE/ISEEU Parificato certificate is final: no supplement, rectification, replacement or update is accepted, except where the Fees, Funding and Housing Office expressly requests a correction or integration
International candidates with income and assets abroad need an ISEEU Parificato from the CAF partnered with Bocconi; submissions to the CAF open from 11 November 2026
The application must be submitted every academic year of enrolment, since the benefit is granted for the year of application and is not automatically renewed
Candidates must not fall under any of the published grounds for exclusion
documents: Attestazione ISEE issued in 2027 for Right to University Education benefits, showing the applicant's fiscal code, its issue date and protocol number
ISEEU Parificato Certificate issued in 2027 by the CAF partnered with Bocconi University, for candidates whose family household resides and produces income outside Italy

The CAF confirmation email for Early Session international candidates, uploaded in the ISEEU section by 30 November 2026, with the corrected ISEEU Parificato Certificate uploaded separately by 11 January 2027

For candidates treated as independent: the employer's CU income declaration for 2025 and 2026, the income tax declaration for the same years, a family registration certificate for the two years prior, and a registered rental agreement in the student's name at an address different from their parents' for 2025 and 2026 with the Agenzia delle Entrati registration receipt
Document attesting completion of the enrolment procedure for a.y. 2027-2028 (enrolment form) for first-year students
All supporting documentation uploaded through the online application portal
existing.english_requirement: The call is published in English and Italian, and Bocconi's degree programmes are taught in English. No separate English language certificate is required by this scholarship.
application_method: For first-year Bachelor of Science or Law applicants, submit the single Bocconi4Access to Education a.y. 2027-2028 application first, within its own deadlines
Obtain an Attestazione ISEE issued in 2027, or an ISEEU Parificato Certificate from the CAF partnered with Bocconi if income and assets are generated outside Italy
Access the online application link published on the deadlines page when the relevant window opens
Fill in all required information about requirements, status, family household, income, entrepreneurial activities and company shares
Upload the supporting documentation, including income and independence evidence
Click "Complete data" and "Submit application" before the window closes
For Early Session international candidates, upload the CAF confirmation email by the application deadline and the corrected ISEEU Parificato by 11 January 2027
existing.selection_notes: Applications are assessed against three independent requirements: enrolment, economics and merit. The economic thresholds are set each year by a resolution of the Lombardy Region, and the a.y. 2027-2028 values are expected only after the Regional Council resolution published between June and July 2027. The merit requirement is verified ex post for first-year Bachelor of Science and Integrated Master of Arts in Law students, so the benefit is confirmed only after the credit threshold is met.
existing.duration: One academic year per application; the benefit is not automatic and must be reapplied for each year of enrolment
existing.application_period: Multiple fixed windows per admission session, not yet open on the verification date: from 12 November 2026 for the first Bachelor of Science and Law international window, then 15 March to 5 April 2027, with Master of Science international rounds between 28 January and 18 June 2027. Applications submitted after the deadline or in a different modality will not be evaluated.
existing.deadline_display: Applications are only accepted within the published windows and cannot be submitted outside them. For first-year Bachelor of Science and Law international candidates the windows are 12 to 30 November 2026 (Early Session and HEC 1st round) and 15 March to 5 April 2027 (Winter Session and HEC 2nd round). For first-year Master of Science international candidates the windows are 28 January to 8 February 2027, 4 to 18 March 2027, 13 to 27 April 2027 and 10 to 18 June 2027.
existing.program_type: Need-based Right to University Education scholarship (cash stipend plus services and supplements), administered by the University and funded by the Lombardy Region and the Italian Ministry of Universities and Research
